summary: Wrote a three-phase plan for Phase 5 of the parent stack-PR design record, scoped strictly to this record's two declared file_scope paths (milestone-review-handoff.sh and its suite). Phase 1 wires the non-fatal cut/show call plus the refusal arm and rewrites the suite's Case 3, closing green because the default fixtures exercise exactly the refusal arm; Phase 2 installs review-stack-prepare.sh in the sandbox and proves the success arm with a new fixture; Phase 3 redeploys and runs the scoped touched-path check. All three premise lines and both suite baselines (18 and 38 passing) were re-measured against live state and confirmed unchanged.
